premises.text: Outsourced PCB fab for prototyping is expensive and slow, and mistakes restart the wait
premises.evidence_span: pay a couple hundred dollars, and wait two weeks for delivery

premises.text: Volterra prints boards in about 60 minutes using silver nanoparticle conductive ink
premises.evidence_span: Our technology uses a silver nanoparticle conductive ink to create the electrical traces

premises.text: Designers keep their existing CAD software and print from it
premises.evidence_span: design their circuit in whatever software they're already comfortable with, and then, as my co-founder Jesus is about to show us, they just press print

premises.text: The tool prints multi-layer boards and can dispense solder paste and bake for beta builds
premises.evidence_span: it'll even dispense solder paste and bake the board for you

premises.text: Recurring revenue from replacement ink cartridges and substrates sold online
premises.evidence_span: purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates directly through our website

premises.text: Engineers and hobbyists want faster electronics prototyping than two-week fab cycles
premises.evidence_span: hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics

premises.text: In-house printing lets larger businesses keep new development on-site against IP leakage
premises.evidence_span: The larger businesses can protect against IP infringement by keeping all the new development in-house

value.text: Hardware developers get custom circuits much faster and cheaper toward manufacturing
value.evidence_span: just help people get there faster and save huge costs along the way

secondary_value.text: Press-print custom circuits without toxic hobby etching
secondary_value.evidence_span: if you need custom circuits, just press print

save huge costs along the way
